site: Shackleton Crater rim — lunar south pole
citation: NASA LRO LOLA polar GDR, south of 87.5 S, 5 m/px
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear
resolution_note: source product is 5 m/px; this 512px grid at 1.25 m/px spans 128.0 source posts and is a 4x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
note: Steep rim ascent. Best public lunar topography anywhere: 5 m/px.
